purpose: Route veterans to toxic exposure benefits and resources. Covers PACT Act burn pit / airborne hazard presumptive claims (primary for OIF/OEF), Agent Orange (Vietnam/Korea/Blue Water Navy), Camp Lejeune water contamination, Gulf War Syndrome, radiation exposure, and PFAS. Surfaces refile opportunities for previously denied claims.
design_note: Most OIF/OEF veterans do not know their conditions are covered by PACT Act (2022) presumptive. Previously denied claims can be refiled. Toxic exposure never blocks — every veteran gets routed.
